Enron.desc: A United States energy company based in Houston, Texas, which owned natural gas pipelines and traded energy; it was described as the largest energy trader in the world. It collapsed and filed for bankruptcy in December 2001, listing $49.8 billion of assets and $31.2 billion of debts.
